Mr. D.S. Mehta, learned counsel for 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Devendra Pant, learned 
Standing Counsel for the 
State/respondent no. 1 and 2.
3. Ms. Kanishka Rautela, learned 
counsel holding brief of Mr. Shailendra 
Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for 
respondent no.3.
4. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior 
Counsel assisted by Ms. Mohd. Shafy 
learned counsel for respondent nos. 4 
and 5.
5. From the perusal of the order sheet, 
it transpires that the counsel for the 
respondent no. 4 and 5 were directed to 
get instructions in the matter by the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court vide 
order dated 25.08.2026. Despite several 
opportunities, the instructions have not 
reached to the Court. 
6. Learned Senior Counsel submits that  till now Vakalatnama has not been given 
by the respondent no. 4 and 5 to the 
assisting counsel and no instructions 
despite communication has been given.
7. In such view of the matter, in order 
to maintain the dignity of this Court, the 
Chief Executive Officer-respondent no. 5 
ITC Ltd., Lalkuan, District Nainital shall 
remain present before this Court on 
26.10.2026.
8. List this case on 26.10.2026.
 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
